chosen_titles.rationale: Legislative Law (LEG) contains Article 1-A, the 'Lobbying Act' (Regulation of Lobbying Act, Ch. 1040/81) - the canonical codification of NY's lobbying-disclosure regime with per-section leaves.
RLA - Regulation of Lobbying Act 1040/81: parallel single-page codification of the same Article 1-A lobbying-disclosure act; included as support/fallback.

notes: NY 2015 available on Justia. Index mirrors NY 2010: both leg/ (Legislative Law, canonical with section leaves) and rla/ (Regulation of Lobbying Act, monolithic page) present. exc/ (Executive Law) deliberately excluded as cross-reference stub, not a disclosure body.
